name: Elyx AI
description: B2B Excel add-in with an AI agent that runs finance workflows (consolidation, reporting, variance analysis) directly in Excel, "every formula verifiable, every cell traceable" (company-stated). Targets accounting firms, industrial SMEs, freelance controllers, SME CFOs and chartered accountants in France. Pricing: Starter €29/mo, Pro €59/mo, Team €119/mo (company-stated). Founded Jun 2023, France. 128 active subscriptions; L30 profit margin 65%. It has "AI" in the name, but the buyer and the job are pure accounting glue.

mentions.indieAngle: Excel/Google Sheets add-in for one local accounting chore: Polish JPK/KSeF reconciliation, VAT split-payment checks, or bank-statement matching. Per-seat, sold to biura rachunkowe (accounting offices).

whyItPrints: Finance teams live in Excel and won't leave. An add-in that sits inside the spreadsheet (not another web app) is the Conductor pattern: meet the legacy tool where it already is. Seller says the recent dip is because he stepped back to do consulting, "not a product issue" (seller-stated).
